Official Privacy & Usage Policy

Last Updated: October 2026 • Applies to all NexTools Temp Mail services

1. Information We Collect & Process

NexTools Temp Mail is built on a strict data-minimization architecture. When you use the Mail Generator:

  • Smart Name Detection: Names typed into the generator (e.g., Alex Jack or Tawsif Ahamed Shuvo) are formatted locally in your browser to assist with signup forms.
  • Email Handles & Domains: Generated email addresses are registered in Firebase solely to prevent duplicate collisions and route incoming messages.
  • No Behavioral Profiling: We never sell, rent, or share user data with third-party advertising networks.

2. Real-Time Inbox & Message Retention

Your temporary inbox is designed for fast, frictionless verification and software QA testing:

  • OTP Parsing: Incoming 4–8 digit verification codes are detected client-side inside your browser for 1-click copying.
  • Instant Deletion: Clicking Delete Email or Clear Inbox immediately removes messages from your view and cloud inbox node.
  • Welcome Mail Auto-Clean: Clicking New Mail automatically removes the initial welcome message so your workspace stays uncluttered.

3. Browser LocalStorage & Preferences

Instead of tracking cookies, NexTools Temp Mail uses standard browser localStorage to remember your workspace state across refreshes:

  • Theme Mode: Stores your Light or Dark UI preference (multimail_theme_v2).
  • Domain Registry: Stores your active 15+ domains and chosen Default Domain (multimail_default_domain_v2).
  • Saved Mails & Password Helper: Keeps your generated email list and custom signup password accessible on your device until you clear them.

4. Acceptable Use & Security Policy

By using NexTools Temp Mail, you agree to abide by the following security and ethical rules:

  • Permitted Uses: Software QA automation, developer webhook testing, trial signups, and protecting your primary inbox from spam.
  • Prohibited Activities: Sending unsolicited bulk spam, phishing, unlawful fraud, or abusing API rate limits is strictly forbidden.
  • Sensitive Accounts Warning: Do not use temporary email addresses for banking, government IDs, or critical medical records.

5. Third-Party Services & Infrastructure

To deliver real-time synchronization and instant customer support, NexTools Mail integrates with trusted cloud providers:

  • Google Firebase Realtime Database: Used for instant username availability checks and live message delivery.
  • Telegram & Google Sheets Support Sync: When you submit a ticket on the Contact Us page, your inquiry is forwarded to our support team.

6. Your Privacy Rights & Data Control

You retain full control over your generated addresses and local workspace data at all times:

  • You can delete individual emails, clear entire inboxes, or wipe your My Generated Mails list with a single click.
  • Click the Clear My Browser Data button above at any time to reset all local storage keys and restore factory defaults.
  • For custom domain takedowns or enterprise compliance inquiries, reach out via our Contact Us page.

Generate 2FA Tokens Instantly

Your fast, free, and secure alternative to mobile authenticator apps.

Protect your online accounts easily without reaching for your phone. Whether you lost your device or simply prefer a desktop solution, our online two-factor authentication (TOTP) tool creates your 6-digit login codes in real-time. Everything is processed entirely inside your own browser—meaning your secret keys are never saved, shared, or sent to any servers. No sign-ups, no tracking, just instant security you can trust.

Unlock the Future of Security

What is 2FA?

2FA is a web-based 2FA Authenticator that generates Time-based One-Time Passwords (TOTP) adhering strictly to RFC 6238 and RFC 4226 standards.

Zero-Knowledge Architecture

Security is paramount. The 2FA auth engine executes 100% locally in your client environment. No network calls, no cookies, no tracking, and zero leaks.

Lightning Fast

Whether you are pasting a setup key or scanning a QR code, 2FA calculates tokens in microseconds with hardware-accelerated Web Cryptography.

How 2FA Works
A Proper Guide to Boosting Your Security

ENABLE 2FA FOR ALL YOUR ACCOUNTS! SECURE YOUR DATA & ACCOUNT TODAY

Think of Two-Factor Authentication (or 2FA for short) as an extra lock on your digital front door. Usually, websites only ask for one thing to let you in: a password. But passwords aren't perfect. They can be guessed, stolen by hackers, or accidentally given away in phishing scams. With 2FA, even if someone obtains your password, they cannot breach your account without your live TOTP code.

Frequently Asked Questions

Instant answers to common questions about 2FA, security, and offline usage.

Is this tool safe to use?
Yes. The NexTools 2FA tool operates on a zero-knowledge, client-side architecture. When you paste your secret key, it never leaves your browser. All cryptographic operations to generate the 2FA tokens are handled entirely by your local device.
Can I use this offline?
Absolutely. Once the web page is fully loaded, you can disconnect from the internet. The TOTP generator relies on your device's system clock and local Javascript, not an active internet connection, making it an incredibly secure authenticator online.
Why is my code being rejected?
Because TOTP codes are inherently time-based, your device's clock must be accurately synchronized. If your computer or phone's clock is off by even a minute, the generated 2FA code will be invalid. Please ensure your system time is set to sync automatically via the internet. Use our "Code Verifier & Drift Check" tool above to test past and future windows!
What secret key formats and services are supported?
We support standard Base32 keys (with or without spaces or dashes, case-insensitive) as well as standard otpauth://totp/... setup URLs and Google Authenticator export QR codes. Works seamlessly with Google, GitHub, Facebook, Binance, Amazon, Microsoft, Discord, Twitter/X, and any RFC 6238 compliant service.
How do I backup my 2FA accounts safely?
Store your original Base32 secret keys or setup QR code images offline in an encrypted password manager (such as Bitwarden, KeePass, or 1Password) or an offline USB drive. Never save unencrypted plaintext keys on cloud notes or email drafts.
What is the difference between TOTP and HOTP?
TOTP (RFC 6238) is time-based, refreshing codes every 30 seconds according to the Unix epoch clock. HOTP (RFC 4226) is counter-based, advancing to the next code only when a login request is made. TOTP is universally preferred by modern services.
Is my secret key stored on any server or cloud?
Never. The application operates under a strict Zero-Knowledge paradigm. All calculations are executed in memory inside your browser. No analytics, tracking pixels, or database connections exist on the backend.
Why does TOTP use a 30-second time step?
RFC 6238 recommends 30 seconds as the optimal equilibrium between user usability (giving you sufficient time to read and type 6 digits) and security (rendering any intercepted code expired and useless almost immediately).
Can I use this as a desktop alternative to mobile authenticators?
Yes! Any account configured with standard Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or Authy can be used directly here by providing its setup key or QR code.
What should I do if my system clock is out of sync?
Enable "Set time automatically" in your operating system date & time settings, or use our "Code Verifier & Drift Check" tool above to diagnose your clock offset.
